notes: Visit type in the queue: each patient is added as كشف, نص كشف, استشارة or كشف مجاني, shown as a badge on the queue row and changeable at any time. The queue header shows the day's total takings. Prices come from Settings — كشف uses the new-visit price, نص كشف the follow-up price, استشارة a new configurable price, and كشف مجاني is always zero. Revenue analytics is now calculated from these queue types instead of the price stored on each visit; the visit-recorded figure is still returned as visitRecordedRevenue for reference.
